QML Mining drilled a new copper‑gold prospect below the existing Mt Chalmers pit in Western Australia, extending exploration from its flagship project. The drill intersected a sizeable interval of potentially mineralised rock, suggesting continued prospects for the company's flagship operation. This development follows ongoing assessments confirming the broader viability of the project's copper and gold targets.
